title: Page 8
content_zh:
这样，一连六七日，药铺里人来人往，惹得旁边的商家都很好奇。听说专门是给妇人看诊的地方，就有地痞之流跑来说些酸话，盯着上门的人上下打量，那目光说不出的淫邪，让人不舒坦。
听见客人说起，童悠悠就给梁浩海送了信，很快，药铺里就多了两个女伙计，都是三十多岁的嫂子，人高马大，碰上在门口探头探脑的闲杂人等，就直接扭了膀子扔出去，心情好了还要在人家后背印上两个脚印，让上门看诊的妇人们别提多解气了。
这个世界，对待妇人始终不如男子那般宽仁，即便轻松解决了这些地痞，童悠悠还是开了药铺的后门，每日为预约的客人看诊，这般尽最大努力保住了病人们的隐私，也让病者更安心。
日子过得说快不快，说慢也不慢，转眼间过了一个月。
中秋佳节，是一年中除了春节之外最大的节日。童悠悠关了一日药铺，专心忙着打理家事，各家走礼，又去徐家坐了坐。
徐家的大胖小子保哥儿养了一个月，更是白胖可爱，无论见了谁都咧嘴咯咯笑，真是令人看了心都要融化了。
徐夫人眼见童悠悠抱着不撒手，就劝她，“既然这么喜欢孩子，就赶紧生一个。有孩子，家里才热闹。你二叔每日下衙，第一件事就是跑回来抱儿子，一天都没耽搁。这男人啊，有孩子就有了根。”
童悠悠心动，害羞点头，玩了大半日就回去了。
可惜计画没有变化快，童悠悠做好了成为母亲的打算，药铺却突然声名大噪，让她忙得顾不上这么多。
原来，徐家胖小子洗三那日，有个夫人曾说儿媳进门四年没开怀，她当真带了儿媳来药铺看诊，而且还是排了第一号，结果这么一个月的药吃下来，儿媳居然怀上了！
先不论男女，家里有后，这可是大事啊！这家人高兴坏了，又不缺银子，更是想趁机同梁家走动起来。于是，这家夫人寻人做了牌匾，敲锣打鼓送到了药铺，牌匾上写着“送子观音”。
童悠悠觉得赞誉太过，毕竟她才为这家儿媳调理一个月，这儿媳能怀孕，大半是因为她本身就没什么大毛病，在药铺吃了定心丸，知道一定能怀上，心情一放松，也就水到渠成。
但从梁浩海到徐家人却都劝她收下，难道那些挂着妙手回春的药铺就真能同阎王抢人命不成？不过是花花轿子众人抬罢了。
童悠悠无法，只能在看诊时慎之又慎，晚上回家还要不停琢磨药方，甚至是药膳、按摩手法，很多时候都是梁浩海抱了她扔到床上……
不但如此，她还主动开口请送牌匾的人家送个贴心的嬷嬷过来，专门带在身边教导了半个月，包括孕妇的饮食、简单的孕妇操和一些护理常识。
那家人简直高兴坏了，送来的嬷嬷回去就贴身伺候少夫人，月银也翻倍，跃升为管事嬷嬷，风光极了。
消息一传出去，很多人都很惊喜，就是再富贵的人家，生个孩子，顶多请个接生婆，大多是外边传言经验丰富的人。
其实经验丰富，不过是做的多了，土方法也多，根本没有经过大夫的指点。倒不是她们不愿意学，而是大夫们都觉得给妇人接生之事脏污，不愿意沾手，甚至不愿意多说一个字。
如今，慈安堂不但专门给妇人看诊，甚至还指点奴仆如何伺候怀身子的妇人，这简直是闻所未闻，也让人分外觉得贴心暖心啊。
于是，就有人上了徐家的门，想请徐夫人帮忙说项，请童悠悠多带几个人，她们宁可花笔银子。

这般，家里儿媳没怀的，可以早些怀上；已经怀上的，也有专业的人手伺候。
徐夫人当然愿意传这个话，童悠悠也应了。
其实她早就想改善一下古代孕妇的待遇，女人身为人妻人母，是个伟大的身分，为何要被当做脏污对待！
第二十二章 圆满过日子(1)
不过几日，童悠悠将慈安堂后门对面的一个小院子买下来，拾掇好了之后，直接开起培训班。
上午时，她在药铺看诊，下午时就到小院子教授这些各家送来的大丫鬟或嬷嬷们，从计算排卵期、经期护理、药膳调节和饮食改善等等，仔细专业。
偶尔前边铺子来了产妇，争得产妇家人的同意，她就带几个想学接生的嬷嬷进去观摩。
当然，这样的机会特别少，药铺开了几个月，也只遇到两次。毕竟，有些观念是多少年累积下来的，不是一时一刻就能改变的。
童悠悠也不心急，她的性情就像水一般，沉稳温柔，但时日久了，水滴也可以穿石。
慈安堂的生意红火，声名大噪，旁人听了，羡慕或者嫉妒，顶多说几句酸话就罢。但童家院子里，童夫人和童芊芊母女却是恨极了。
童悠悠本事如此大，医术如此好，可见当初病重是假装的，被童芊芊抢了亲事自然也是她愿意的。
母女俩从来不觉得她们不该算计、不该下毒害他人，反倒怨怪童悠悠瞒骗了她们。
童芊芊更是每天像疯婆子一样，奴仆们私下说话，每次被她听见梁浩海对妻子多娇宠，药铺生意多兴隆，她就摔东西，打骂奴仆。因为她一直认为，这些东西原本都该是她的！
“那个该死的贱人！是她抢了我的夫君，抢了我的药铺，呜呜呜，我要杀了她，杀了她！”
童夫人还有几分理智，耐心劝着，“好了，芊芊，咱们再等等，以后有机会再收拾她。”
但童芊芊已经疯魔了，哪听得进去这些话，今日绝食，明日上吊，逼着老娘想办法。
童夫人只能搜刮最后一点银子，吩咐路婆子出去寻人假扮病人到慈安堂去闹事。
当初就没跟着童芊芊陪嫁到吴府的路婆子，因每隔七日还要到春晖园墙根下讨解药吃，哪里敢算计童悠悠，一出了门，自然是赶紧去报信。
当晚，她回到童家时，就小心禀告，“夫人，我找到人选了，但那家的男人不同意，怕您说话不算数，一定要见您一面，还要当场就拿到五十两银子的订金，才肯让他家婆娘动手。”
童夫人有些迟疑。

路婆子又道：“那家婆娘怀了鬼胎，治不好，是去药铺闹事最好的人选。”
所谓鬼胎，就是妇人肚子大得如同怀孕，却没有孩子，简直是妇人们最害怕的病症，从古至今，根本没有大夫治好过。
童夫人立刻来了兴致，想象童悠悠因此身败名裂，她就什么都不顾了。
“好，你去安排，今晚见一面，最好在附近，防备老爷突然回来。”
“是，夫人放心，正好咱们家后门的小巷里姓孙的两口子去走亲戚，可以借她家地方一用。”
两人商量妥当，当晚，藉着月色，童夫人蒙了披风就去了孙家院子。
孙家院子里果然有一对夫妻，妇人肚子很大，男人看着有些像地痞，斜着眼睛，开口闭口都是银子。
童夫人心里看不起他们，但也去了疑心。
这男人歪缠得厉害，童夫人说得口干舌燥，不知不觉就端起桌上的茶水喝了几口，没一会儿，她就觉得眼前开始模糊……
“贱人！你在做什么！”
童夫人不知道睡了多久，突然被人狠狠地在脸上甩了两巴掌，火辣辣的疼惊得她猛然坐了起来，胸前似有什么滑下来，凉飕飕的，让她下意识一看，却见到自己白花花的胸脯。
content_en:
In this way, for six or seven days in a row, people came and went in the drug store, making the nearby merchants very curious. I heard that in a place dedicated to treating women, there would be scoundrels who would come and say some mean things and stare at the people who came to the door, looking at them with indescribable lewdness, which made people uncomfortable.
Hearing the customer talking about it, Tong Youyou sent a letter to Liang Haohai. Soon, there were two more female clerks in the drug store. They were both sisters-in-law in their thirties. They were tall and tall. When they met the idle people peeking at the door, they would throw them out. When they were in a good mood, they would leave two footprints on their backs, so that the women who came to see the doctor would be relieved.
In this world, women are never as lenient as men. Even though these gangsters were easily dealt with, Tong Youyou still opened the back door of the pharmacy and saw patients who made appointments every day. In this way, she tried her best to protect the privacy of the patients and made the patients feel more at ease.
The days passed quickly or slowly, and a month passed in the blink of an eye.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is the biggest festival of the year after the Spring Festival. Tong Youyou closed the medicine shop for a day and concentrated on taking care of housework. She went to each family to give gifts and then went to Xu's house to sit for a while.
The Xu family's fat boy, Bao Geer, has been raised for a month. He is white, plump and cute. He grins and giggles no matter who he sees. It makes people's hearts melt.
Mrs. Xu saw that Tong Youyou was hugging her and wouldn't let go, so she advised her, "Since you like children so much, you should hurry up and have one. The family will be lively when you have children. Your second uncle goes to the office every day, and the first thing he does is run back to hug his son, and he doesn't waste a day. This man is rooted in having children."
Tong Youyou was moved, nodded shyly, and went back after playing for most of the day.
Unfortunately, the plan did not change quickly. Tong Youyou had made plans to become a mother, but the drug store suddenly became famous, making her too busy to take care of so much.
It turned out that on the day of the Xu family's fat boy's third bath, a lady once said that her daughter-in-law had not been pregnant for four years. She actually brought her daughter-in-law to the drug store for treatment, and she was the first in line. After taking the medicine for such a month, her daughter-in-law actually became pregnant!
Regardless of whether you are a man or a woman, having a daughter-in-law is a big deal! The family was extremely happy, and they were not short of money, so they even wanted to take the opportunity to travel with the Liang family. So the lady of the family found someone to make a plaque and delivered it to the medicine shop with gongs and drums. The plaque read "Send Son Guanyin".
Tong Youyou felt that the praise was too much. After all, she had only nursed her daughter-in-law for a month. The reason why her daughter-in-law was able to get pregnant was mostly because she had no serious problems. She took reassurance pills at the drug store and knew that she would be pregnant. Once she relaxed, it was a matter of course.
But everyone from Liang Haohai to the Xu family persuaded her to accept it. Could it be that those drugstores with magic tricks to rejuvenate people could really compete with the King of Hell to snatch people's lives? It's just a sedan chair carried by everyone.
Tong Youyou had no choice but to be cautious when seeing a doctor. When she got home at night, she had to keep thinking about prescriptions, even medicinal diets and massage techniques. Many times, Liang Haohai picked her up and threw her on the bed...
Not only that, she also took the initiative to ask the person who sent the plaque to send a caring nanny over, and she stayed with her to teach her for half a month, including the diet of pregnant women, simple exercises for pregnant women, and some common nursing knowledge.
The family was so happy that the nanny who was sent there took care of the young lady personally when she got back. Her monthly income doubled and she was promoted to the position of nun in charge, which was a great success.
As soon as the news spread, many people were surprised. No matter how wealthy a family was, when they gave birth to a child, they would at most hire a midwife, most of whom were experienced people according to external rumors.
In fact, I have a lot of experience, but I have done too much and used many local methods without any guidance from a doctor. It's not that they don't want to learn, it's that the doctors all feel that midwifery is a dirty job, and they don't want to get involved, or even say a word.
Nowadays, Ci'an Tang not only specializes in treating women, but also instructs slaves on how to serve pregnant women. This is simply unheard of, and it is also surprising.You have to be considerate and warm.
So, someone came to the Xu family's door and wanted to ask Mrs. Xu to help with the matter. They asked Tong Youyou to bring more people. They would rather spend some money.
In this way, if the daughter-in-law is not pregnant, she can get pregnant earlier; if she is already pregnant, there will also be professional staff to take care of her.
Of course Mrs. Xu was willing to spread the word, and Tong Youyou agreed.
In fact, she has long wanted to improve the treatment of pregnant women in ancient times. As a wife and mother, a woman has a great status, so why should she be treated like dirt!
Chapter 22 Living a Happy Life (1)
Within a few days, Tong Youyou bought a small yard opposite the back door of Ci'an Hall. After tidying it up, she started training classes directly.
In the morning, she consulted at the drug store, and in the afternoon she went to the small courtyard to teach the maids or nuns sent by various families, from calculating ovulation, menstrual care, medicated diet adjustment, diet improvement, etc., in a careful and professional manner.
Occasionally, a pregnant woman would come to the front shop, and with the consent of her family, she would bring a few nuns who wanted to learn how to deliver babies in to observe.
Of course, such opportunities are extremely rare. In the few months since the drug store has been open, we have only encountered it twice. After all, some concepts have been accumulated over many years and cannot be changed in an instant.
Tong Youyou is not impatient. Her temperament is like water, calm and gentle, but over time, water droplets can penetrate stone.
Ci'antang's business is booming and its reputation is very high. When others hear about it, they will be envious or jealous, and at most they will say a few sarcastic words. But in the Tong family's yard, Mrs. Tong and Tong Qianqian's mother and daughter were filled with hatred.
Tong Youyou is so capable and has such good medical skills. It can be seen that she was pretending to be seriously ill at the beginning, and she was naturally willing to be robbed of her marriage by Tong Qianqian.
The mother and daughter never felt that they should not scheme or poison others. Instead, they blamed Tong Youyou for deceiving them.
Tong Qianqian acted like a crazy woman every day. The slaves talked privately. Every time she heard how doting Liang Haohai was on his wife and how prosperous the drug store was, she would throw things and beat and scold the slaves. Because she always believed that these things should originally be hers!
"That damn bitch! It was she who robbed my husband and my medicine shop. Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, I'm going to kill her, kill her!"
Mrs. Tong still had some sense and patiently advised her, "Okay, Qianqian, let's wait and deal with her later when we have the opportunity."
But Tong Qianqian was already crazy and could not listen to these words. She went on a hunger strike today and hanged herself tomorrow, forcing her to find a way.
Mrs. Tong could only scrape the last bit of money and ordered Mrs. Lu to go out and find someone to pretend to be a patient and go to Ci'an Hall to cause trouble.
Mrs. Lu, who had not followed Tong Qianqian to marry into the Wu Mansion, had to go to the Chunhui Garden wall every seven days to ask for antidote, so she didn't dare to plot against Tong Youyou. As soon as she left the house, she naturally rushed to report the news.
That night, when she returned to Tong's house, she carefully reported, "Madam, I have found a candidate, but the man from that family does not agree. He is afraid that your words will not be kept true. He must meet you and get a deposit of fifty taels of silver on the spot before he is willing to let his mother-in-law take action."
Mrs. Tong hesitated.
Mrs. Lu added: "That woman is pregnant with a ghost fetus and cannot be cured. She is the best candidate to go to the drug store to cause trouble."
The so-called ghost fetus means that a woman's belly is as big as if she is pregnant, but she does not have a child. It is simply the disease that women fear most. From ancient times to the present, no doctor has ever cured it.
Mrs. Tong immediately became interested, imagining that Tong Youyou would be ruined because of this, she didn't care about anything.
"Okay, you go and make arrangements to meet tonight. It's best to be nearby in case the master comes back suddenly."
"Yes, madam, don't worry. It just so happens that the couple named Sun in the alley behind our house are visiting relatives, so we can borrow her place."
The two of them discussed it, and that night, under the moonlight, Mrs. Tong put on her cloak and went to the Sun family yard.
As expected, there was a couple in the Sun family's yard. The woman had a big belly, and the man looked a bit like a gangster, with squinting eyes and a silver tongue.son.
Mrs. Tong looked down on them in her heart, but she also lost her suspicion.
This man was so entangled that Mrs. Tong's mouth went dry. She unknowingly picked up the tea on the table and took a few sips. After a while, she felt that her vision began to blur...
"Bitch! What are you doing!"
Mrs. Tong didn't know how long she had been sleeping, but she was suddenly slapped twice hard on the face. The burning pain made her sit up suddenly. Something seemed to slide down her chest, which was so cold that she subconsciously took a look and saw her own white breasts.
